projects.title: HPI-SCALE — Global Prosperity Platform: operating model transformation
projects.description: Move HPI from isolated local case studies to a mechanism-based, reusable open research platform with four connected pillars, without claiming adoption, partnerships or measured human benefit. Canonical issue https://github.com/svtmzt/human-prosperity-initiative/issues/96. Gate: Strategy, theory of change, ADR-0004 and the four pillars are implemented technically. The charter addendum is a candidate registered as open under F0-01; independent review, legal structure, safeguarding, data controller, human accessibility testing and fieldwork approval remain open (#103). HubOS production synchronisation is a pending manifest, not executed.

projects.title: GPI — Global Prosperity Intelligence
projects.description: A small, reproducible, source-traceable knowledge base connecting problems, mechanisms, interventions, evidence and contexts, with provenance, comparability checks and declared gaps. Canonical issue https://github.com/svtmzt/human-prosperity-initiative/issues/97. Gate: Citation-and-provenance knowledge base implemented and build-validated. RT-02.6 NO-GO on dataset ingestion remains in force. Independent methodological review, full-text extraction, retraction checks and qualified licence review are outstanding.

projects.title: SEE — Solutions & Experimentation Engine
projects.description: Reusable, testable intervention and evaluation designs, starting with a verified-receipt package for administrative barriers to benefit access in Newham, Recife and Naples. Canonical issue https://github.com/svtmzt/human-prosperity-initiative/issues/98. Gate: Benefit-access package at maturity level 3 (prototype). Level 4 requires an approved protocol, lawful outcome data, independent methods review (G-05) and ethics approval (G-04). No intervention is implemented or recommended.

projects.title: GAN — Global Adoption Network
projects.description: A public self-service toolkit to discover, scrutinise and adapt HPI resources, with licences, maturity, readiness checks and contribution pathways. No adopters or partners exist. Canonical issue https://github.com/svtmzt/human-prosperity-initiative/issues/99. Gate: Toolkit implemented. Adoption and partnership registers are empty by design and accept only independently verified public evidence. No confidential intake exists (#26).

projects.title: ESL — Economic Systems Lab
projects.description: Open research on how growth, productivity, wages, employment and essential costs translate into household security, with a reproducible illustrative model. Canonical issue https://github.com/svtmzt/human-prosperity-initiative/issues/100. Gate: Research agenda and MODEL-HHR-01 implemented with synthetic inputs. Not a forecast; not calibrated; independent review (G-05) required before any empirical use.

projects.title: HPI-AI — AI research assistance and evidence reliability
projects.description: A tested, disabled-by-default AI research-assistance layer with grounding, citation verification, injection defence and human review; no paid inference. Canonical issue https://github.com/svtmzt/human-prosperity-initiative/issues/101. Gate: Adapter and safeguards implemented and tested against simulated transports. No inference provider is connected in production and no AI-generated content is published. Live evaluation requires an available local or explicitly approved provider.

projects.title: HPI-QA — Integrated quality, security and release verification
projects.description: Meaningful automated tests and release verification for the platform while preserving every existing CircleCI and Vercel gate. Canonical issue https://github.com/svtmzt/human-prosperity-initiative/issues/102. Gate: Local tests and browser QA are required before push; CircleCI and Vercel must pass on the exact SHA before merge. Real assistive-technology testing (G-06) remains open.
